title: Find Pivot Index
goal: Find the leftmost index whose strictly left and strictly right sums are equal.
strategy: Compute the total once. Before consuming each value, compare the completed left sum with the remaining right sum.

phasePurposes.inspect: Compute the total once. Before consuming each value, compare the completed left sum with the remaining right sum.
phasePurposes.update: The pivot itself belongs to neither side sum.
phasePurposes.done: The pivot itself belongs to neither side sum.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
